sources.description: Reporting user's supplied redacted incident narrative; claims not independently reproduced in this public package.
Separate restricted working archive; not cleared for public distribution and not copied into this repository.

incidents.failureClass: Inconsistent safety assessment across sessions, as reported.
Retrieved tool output was reportedly attributed to the user.
Incorrect behavioral inference reportedly inserted into context as fact.
Reported correct handling of obfuscated prompt injection; positive counterexample.

findings.statement: Reporter recorded a Splunk HEC ingestion endpoint, a local queue, and a successful upload at 20:27 local time on 25 August 2026.
findings.verificationNeeded: Independently inspect time-scoped endpoint configuration and redacted queue/send receipts; do not disclose HEC authentication.

findings.statement: Reporter observed HEC and Google geolocation API credentials in local client configuration; no credential values are reproduced.
findings.verificationNeeded: Inspect safely redacted configuration and determine credential scope, rotation and intended public-client exposure.

findings.statement: Reported package metadata lists Sentry Electron 7.11.0, electron-log 4.4.8, electron-updater 6.8.9, better-sqlite3 13.0.1, uuid 8.3.2, HTTP and WebSocket clients, and an internal AI integration.
findings.verificationNeeded: Match dependency declarations to the captured package manifest; presence does not prove execution.

findings.statement: Reporter states that notion.db opens as ordinary SQLite and includes a microsoft_oauth table associated with the reporting account.
findings.verificationNeeded: Inspect only schema and counts with account IDs and sensitive values withheld; independently confirm storage protections.

findings.statement: Reporter observed a repeated 43-character Base64 value that decodes to approximately 32 bytes with a leading zero byte; the value itself is withheld.
findings.verificationNeeded: Trace producer, column semantics, cryptographic APIs and safe test fixtures rather than guessing from appearance.

findings.statement: Whether the opaque value is ciphertext, a key, a token, or non-sensitive metadata; credential exposure and key-management adequacy are not established.
findings.verificationNeeded: Establish column semantics and whether application-controlled data can be decrypted or replayed using authorized non-production material.

findings.statement: Captured environment reportedly used Notion Desktop 7.31.2, Electron 42.4.1, Chromium 148.0.7778.265 and a Notion-signed executable.
findings.verificationNeeded: Check version manifests and Authenticode signature from the dated local capture; do not generalize to current releases.

findings.statement: Reporter recorded a 20.2 MB notion.db with 49 tables and 11 indexes, approximately 2.17 GB local app data, and an open-at-login registry entry.
findings.verificationNeeded: Reproduce file-system, SQLite metadata and registry observations on the original captured environment only.

findings.statement: A single origin/context ambiguity mechanism caused all incidents; this causal link has not been established.
findings.verificationNeeded: Conduct controlled origin-tagging and cross-session experiments; include the positive counterexample in evaluation.

demands.request: Structurally tag retrieved content separately from user-authored messages.
Avoid unsupported intent attribution; state only that instructions embedded in content were ignored.
Provide an appeal/correction path when a user disputes an attribution.
Improve cross-session consistency in safety assessments and provide an appeal path.
Expose inferred memory with correction and deletion controls.
Mark behavioral inference explicitly as inference when included in context.
Minimize behavioral context that is not required for the current task.

requestedResolutions.request: Reporter requests full subscription-fee refund and a written acknowledgement/apology.
Alternative requested outcome: full-access upgrade for the remaining subscription term at no additional charge.
